value.rationale: A sharp orientation-dependent change of ordering of standardized quantization-error fourth moments is substantive information that the classical second-moment optimality theorem cannot determine. The exact quartic surface separates a region where FCC has lower projected kurtosis from a complementary region where BCC is lower, even while BCC has uniformly better two natural radial standardized fourth and sixth moments; this provides a complete direction-sensitive comparison for two canonical lattice-tiling solids.
